brief: The 6-tool SaaS starter stack in 2026 — from auth to payments to deploy in one weekend.

slots.tagline: The React framework for production-grade apps with server components and fast refreshes.
slots.f1Body: File-based routing with layouts and loading states requires zero configuration.
slots.f2Body: Render async data on the server to cut client JavaScript bundles.
slots.f3Body: Deploy serverless functions alongside your UI for a unified codebase.

slots.tagline: Open-source Firebase alternative that spins up Postgres, auth, and real-time APIs in minutes.
slots.f1Body: Row-level security and instant APIs give you enterprise data safety.
slots.f2Body: Magic links, OAuth, and email providers wired to your users table.
slots.f3Body: Subscribe to database changes for live UI updates without WebSocket boilerplate.

slots.tagline: The payments platform that lets you bill customers, manage subscriptions, and handle tax compliance.
slots.f1Body: Metered plans and trials automate recurring revenue with webhooks.
slots.f2Body: Automatic VAT and sales tax calculation keeps you compliant worldwide.
slots.f3Body: Pre-built payment pages reduce PCI scope and boost conversion rates.

slots.tagline: Deploy Next.js to a global edge network with previews, analytics, and zero-config CI.
slots.f1Body: Every push generates a live preview URL for team review and QA.
slots.f2Body: Run middleware and API routes close to users for sub-50ms cold starts.
slots.f3Body: Real-world Core Web Vitals tracking shows exactly where speed lags.

slots.tagline: An AI-first code editor that predicts your intent, refactors instantly, and ships features faster.
slots.f1Body: Multi-line edits autocomplete before you finish typing the thought.
slots.f2Body: Ask questions across your entire codebase with inline file references.
slots.f3Body: Transform legacy patterns to modern syntax without breaking TypeScript types.

slots.tagline: Fair-code automation that wires your SaaS together with visual workflows and custom webhooks.
slots.f1Body: Drag nodes to connect APIs without writing brittle glue code.
slots.f2Body: Start flows from Stripe events or database changes in real time.
slots.f3Body: Keep execution data inside your VPC for strict security requirements.

slots.ctaBody: Copy this exact stack and ship your first paying customer before Monday. No boilerplate required.
